# atomvm-cbor 0.3.1

`atomvm_cbor` 0.3.1 is a documentation-compatibility patch. It replaces the
README Mermaid benchmark blocks with deterministic static SVG assets so the
three-board current-release comparison renders correctly on both GitHub and
Hex.pm.

## What changed

- Added static SVG charts for ESP32-S3 N16R8, WaveShare N32R16V, and RP2040.
- Kept chart values generated from the retained structured release evidence;
  no values were manually copied or changed.
- Updated package and documentation version surfaces to 0.3.1.

There are no runtime-code, public-API, supported-runtime, benchmark-value,
performance-threshold, or coverage-threshold changes from 0.3.0. No host or
physical-device benchmark was repeated.

## Retained exact evidence

The 0.3.1 documentation package reuses the exact 0.2.0 to 0.3.0 evidence. These
are three separate targets and are not collapsed into a generic ESP32 row.

| WaveShare N32R16V | ESP32-S3-DEV-KIT-N32R16V, MAC `90:e5:b1:d8:48:b0`, CH340 UART serial `5B61092782` | 240 MHz | 32 MiB OPI/DTR flash / 16 MiB octal PSRAM, both 80 MHz |
| RP2040 E462… | RP2040 B2, BOOTSEL serial `E0C9125B0D9B`, flash ID `E46254C5C32D122C` | 133 MHz | 16 MiB flash / 264 KiB SRAM |

## Installation

Rebar3:

```erlang
{deps, [
    {avm_cbor, "~> 0.3.1", {pkg, atomvm_cbor}}
]}.
```

Mix:

```elixir
{:avm_cbor, "~> 0.3.1", hex: :atomvm_cbor}
```

Publication is bound to the annotated `0.3.1` tag and a successful exact-tag
release gate for the same commit SHA.
